name: Visual Quality
blurb: Aesthetic appeal and technical fidelity, computed per detected shot so that transition frames do not contaminate the score.

metrics.name: Aesthetic Score
metrics.text: Composition, lighting and colour, rated by Q-Align on each shot and aggregated over shots.

metrics.name: Perceptual Score
metrics.text: Technical artifacts and blur, rated by DeQA-Score on each shot and aggregated over shots.

name: Dynamic Quality
blurb: Whether the video contains meaningful motion, and whether that motion is physically credible.

metrics.name: Dynamic Degree
metrics.text: Subject and camera dynamics from DEVIL, calibrated against human motion ratings. Measured strictly inside shot intervals, so cuts and transitions are not counted as motion.

metrics.name: Physical Plausibility
metrics.text: A VLM judge (Qwen3.8) looks for physical anomalies: unnatural anatomical deformation, objects that vanish, implausible interactions.

name: Semantic Alignment
blurb: How faithfully the video realises the structured script: events, transition style, cut timing and camera language.

metrics.name: VQA-Score
metrics.text: Binary questions probe whether scripted events occur. Each question is tied to its target shot, and full credit is given only when the event appears in the intended shot.

metrics.name: Transition Control & Cut Timing
metrics.text: TC checks that each requested transition occurs (TC-V) and has the requested type (TC-A): hard cut, dissolve, fade or wipe, detected by OmniShotCut and TransVLM with Qwen3.8 resolving ambiguous cases. CTA measures, in seconds, how closely the generated boundaries follow the requested timeline.

metrics.name: Camera Control
metrics.text: For every matched shot, FilmOps operators predict shot scale, camera angle and camera movement, which are compared with the script.

name: Cross-Shot Consistency
blurb: Whether entities, backgrounds and faces survive the cut. Each sub-metric is computed only on scripts annotated with the corresponding relation, and reported as a validity rate (-V) plus a conditional score (-S).

metrics.name: Entity Consistency
metrics.text: Qwen3.8 locates the recurring entities across shots and rates on a 1–5 scale whether shape, proportions, colour, materials and clothing stay consistent. Changes explained by viewpoint, pose or the script are not penalised.

metrics.name: Background Consistency
metrics.text: Qwen3.8 compares only shots that the script assigns to the same scene and rates the continuity of spatial layout, fixed structures and textures, without penalising differences in viewpoint or lighting.

metrics.name: Face Consistency
metrics.text: InsightFace detects faces in every shot, Qwen3.8 picks the target person, and identity features are compared across shots with calibrated nearest-neighbour similarity.
